assessmentbasics.abkey.desc: A VARCHAR(30) primary key for each assessment (e.g., 'AB001')

assessmentbasics.atype.desc: An enum (assessmenttype_enum) capturing the assessment type (Initial, Emergency, Routine, Follow-up)

assessmentbasics.amethod.desc: An enum (assessmentmethod_enum) for how the assessment was done (Phone, Self-report, In-person, Telehealth)

assessmentbasics.adurmin.desc: A SMALLINT indicating assessment duration in minutes (e.g., 45)

assessmentbasics.alang.desc: An enum (assessmentlanguage_enum) describing which language was used (Chinese, French, Spanish, English, Other)

assessmentbasics.avalid.desc: An enum (assessmentvalidity_enum) capturing validity (Questionable, Invalid, Valid)

assessmentbasics.respconsist.desc: An enum (responseconsistency_enum) describing response consistency (Medium, High, Low)

assessmentbasics.symptvalid.desc: An enum (symptomvalidity_enum) describing symptom validity (Questionable, Valid, Invalid)

assessmentbasics.patownerref.desc: A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing Patients(PatKey), linking the assessment to its patient

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.asdkey.desc: A VARCHAR(30) primary key matching ABKey from AssessmentBasics (FK)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.recstatus.desc: An enum (recoverystatus_enum) describing recovery status (Relapse, Stable, Advanced, Early)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.socsup.desc: An enum (socialsupportlevel_enum) measuring social support (Strong, Limited, Moderate)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.faminv.desc: An enum (familyinvolvement_enum) indicating family involvement level (Low, High, Medium)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.relqual.desc: An enum (relationshipquality_enum) describing overall relationship quality (Poor, Conflicted, Good, Fair)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.workfunc.desc: An enum (workfunctioning_enum) referencing work functioning (Disabled, Poor, Fair, Good)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.socfunc.desc: An enum (socialfunctioning_enum) referencing social functioning (Isolated, Fair, Good, Poor)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.adlfunc.desc: An enum (adlfunctioning_enum) describing ADL performance (Minimal Help, Independent, Moderate Help, Dependent)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.strslvl.desc: A NUMERIC(3,1) measuring perceived stress level (e.g., 6.0)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.copskill.desc: An enum (copingskills_enum) capturing coping skill quality (Good, Poor, Fair, Limited)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.inlevel.desc: An enum (insightlevel_enum) describing insight (Fair, Good, Poor)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.motivlevel.desc: An enum (motivationlevel_enum) referencing motivation (High, Low, Medium)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.primdx.desc: An enum (primarydx_enum) for the primary diagnosis (Anxiety, PTSD, Bipolar, Schizophrenia, Depression)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.secdx.desc: An enum (secondarydx_enum) for secondary diagnosis (OCD, Personality Disorder, Substance Use, Eating Disorder)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.dxdurm.desc: A SMALLINT specifying diagnosis duration in months (e.g., 12)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.lasthospdt.desc: A DATE capturing the date of the last hospitalization (e.g., '2025-01-10')

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.qolscr.desc: A SMALLINT measuring Quality of Life score (0–100)

assessmentsocialanddiagnosis.funcimp.desc: An enum (functionalimpairment_enum) describing functional impairment (Severe, Moderate, Mild)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.asrkey.desc: A VARCHAR(30) primary key matching ABKey from AssessmentBasics (FK)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.suicideation.desc: An enum (suicidalideation_enum) capturing suicidal ideation (Intent, Active, Plan, Passive)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.suicrisk.desc: An enum (suiciderisk_enum) describing suicide risk level (Medium, High, Low, Severe)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.selfharm.desc: An enum (selfharm_enum) indicating self-harm history (Recent, Past, Current)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.violrisk.desc: An enum (violencerisk_enum) for violence risk (Medium, Low, High)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.subuse.desc: An enum (substanceuse_enum) describing which substance is used (Cannabis, Opioids, Alcohol, Multiple)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.subusefreq.desc: An enum (substanceusefrequency_enum) for how often substances are used (Daily, Never, Occasional, Regular)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.subusesev.desc: An enum (substanceuseseverity_enum) describing severity (Mild, Moderate, Severe)

assessmentsymptomsandrisk.mental_health_.desc: JSONB column. Aggregates scores related to mental health symptoms and risk factors, such as depression, anxiety, and other symptom metrics

clinicians.clinkey.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the clinician (e.g., 'CLN001')

clinicians.clinconf.desc: An enum (clinicianconfidence_enum) capturing the clinician's confidence (Medium, Low, High)

clinicians.assesslim.desc: An enum (assessmentlimitations_enum) describing any limitations (Cognitive, Engagement, Language)

clinicians.docustat.desc: An enum (documentationstatus_enum) for documentation status (Complete, Incomplete, Pending)

clinicians.billcode.desc: A VARCHAR(15) storing billing or service code (e.g., '99214')

clinicians.nxtrevdt.desc: A DATE indicating next planned review date (e.g., '2025-06-01')

clinicians.carecoord.desc: An enum (carecoordination_enum) describing care coordination level (Intensive, Regular, Limited)

clinicians.refneed.desc: An enum (referralneeds_enum) capturing referral needs (Services, Testing, Specialist)

clinicians.fuptype.desc: An enum (followuptype_enum) describing follow-up type (Therapy, Routine, Urgent, Medication Check)

clinicians.fupfreq.desc: An enum (followupfrequency_enum) describing follow-up frequency (Weekly, Quarterly, Biweekly, Monthly)

clinicians.facconnect.desc: A VARCHAR(20) FK referencing Facilities(FacKey), linking this clinician to a facility

encounters.enckey.desc: A VARCHAR(30) primary key identifying the encounter (e.g., 'ENC001')

encounters.timemark.desc: A TIMESTAMP for when the encounter or record was created/logged

encounters.clinid.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing the clinician ID (not an enforced FK)

encounters.facid.desc: A VARCHAR(20) referencing the facility ID (not an enforced FK)

encounters.missappt.desc: A NUMERIC(2,1) capturing how many appointments were missed or how frequently (e.g., 1.0)

encounters.txbarrier.desc: An enum (treatmentbarriers_enum) indicating barriers to treatment (Multiple, Time, Financial, Transportation)

encounters.nxapptdt.desc: A DATE capturing the next appointment date (e.g., '2025-06-10')

encounters.dqscore.desc: A SMALLINT data quality score (0–100 scale)

encounters.assesscomplete.desc: A VARCHAR(250) note on assessment completeness (e.g., 'Sections B & C incomplete')

facilities.fackey.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying the facility (e.g., 'FAC001')

facilities.rsource.desc: An enum (referralsource_enum) for how the patient was referred (Self, Court, Physician, Emergency, Family)

facilities.envstress.desc: An enum (environmentalstressors_enum) describing stressors in the environment (Mild, Moderate, Severe)

facilities.lifeimpact.desc: An enum (lifeeventsimpact_enum) showing how life events impact the patient (Mild, Moderate, Severe)

facilities.seasonpat.desc: An enum (seasonalpattern_enum) capturing any seasonal pattern in symptoms (Summer, Winter, Variable)

facilities.leglissue.desc: An enum (legalissues_enum) describing the patient's legal issues (Resolved, Pending, Ongoing)

facilities.ssystemchg.desc: An enum (supportsystemchanges_enum) describing changes in support system (Variable, Improved, Declined)

facilities.support_and_resources.desc: JSONB column. Stores information about the facility's support services, community resources, emergency contacts, and plan statuses

patients.patkey.desc: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each patient (e.g., 'PAT001')

patients.patage.desc: A SMALLINT indicating the patient's age in years

patients.patgender.desc: An enum (patientgender_enum) for the patient's gender (Other, F, M)

patients.pateth.desc: An enum (patientethnicity_enum) indicating the patient's ethnicity (Other, Hispanic, African, Asian, Caucasian)

patients.edulevel.desc: An enum (educationlevel_enum) describing highest education achieved (High School, Other, Bachelor, Master, Doctorate)

patients.empstat.desc: An enum (employmentstatus_enum) capturing employment status (Retired, Employed, Unemployed, Disabled, Student)

patients.maristat.desc: An enum (maritalstatus_enum) describing marital status (Widowed, Married, Single, Divorced)

patients.livingarr.desc: An enum (livingarrangement_enum) for living arrangement (Alone, Partner, Family, Group Home, Homeless)

patients.insurtype.desc: An enum (insurancetype_enum) referencing type of insurance (Medicaid, Medicare, Private)

patients.insurstat.desc: An enum (insurancestatus_enum) describing insurance status (Pending, Approved, Denied)

patients.disabstat.desc: An enum (disabilitystatus_enum) indicating disability status (Pending, Permanent, Temporary)

patients.housestable.desc: An enum (housingstability_enum) describing housing stability (Homeless, Stable, At Risk, Unstable)

patients.cultfactor.desc: An enum (culturalfactors_enum) capturing relevant cultural factors (Language, Beliefs, Family, Multiple)

patients.stigmaimp.desc: An enum (stigmaimpact_enum) describing stigma impact (Moderate, Mild, Severe)

patients.finstress.desc: An enum (financialstress_enum) describing financial stress level (Severe, Mild, Moderate)

treatmentbasics.txkey.desc: A SERIAL primary key for each treatment record (e.g., 101)

treatmentbasics.curmed.desc: A TEXT field listing current medications (e.g., 'SSRIs, Mood stabilizer')

treatmentbasics.medadh.desc: An enum (medicationadherence_enum) for medication adherence (Medium, Low, Non-compliant, High)

treatmentbasics.medside.desc: An enum (medicationsideeffects_enum) describing side effect severity (Mild, Moderate, Severe)

treatmentbasics.medchg.desc: An enum (medicationchanges_enum) for medication changes (Dose Adjustment, Augmentation, Switch)

treatmentbasics.crisisint.desc: A NUMERIC(2,1) capturing any crisis interventions count or measure (e.g., 2.0)

treatmentbasics.therapy_details.desc: JSONB column. Captures details about the therapy provided, including type, frequency, duration, engagement, and changes

treatmentoutcomes.txoutkey.desc: A SERIAL primary key for treatment outcome records (e.g., 201)

treatmentoutcomes.thprog.desc: An enum (therapyprogress_enum) describing therapy progress (Fair, Good, Poor)

treatmentoutcomes.txadh.desc: An enum (treatmentadherence_enum) referencing overall treatment adherence (Non-compliant, Medium, Low, High)

treatmentoutcomes.txresp.desc: An enum (treatmentresponse_enum) for treatment response (Poor, Good, Partial)

treatmentoutcomes.sideburd.desc: An enum (sideeffectburden_enum) describing side effect burden (Mild, Moderate, Severe)

treatmentoutcomes.txgoalstat.desc: An enum (treatmentgoalsstatus_enum) for treatment goals status (Not Started, Achieved, In Progress, Modified)

treatmentoutcomes.recgoalstat.desc: An enum (recoverygoalsstatus_enum) for recovery goals status (Not Started, Achieved, In Progress, Modified)

treatmentoutcomes.sympimp.desc: An enum (symptomimprovement_enum) indicating symptom improvement (Moderate, Minimal, Significant)

treatmentoutcomes.funcimpv.desc: An enum (functionalimprovement_enum) capturing functional improvement (Moderate, Minimal, Significant)

treatmentoutcomes.workstatchg.desc: An enum (workstatuschanges_enum) referencing changes in work status (Leave, Reduced Hours, Terminated)

treatmentoutcomes.theralliance.desc: An enum (therapeuticalliance_enum) describing alliance (Moderate, Poor, Strong, Weak)

treatmentoutcomes.txeng.desc: An enum (treatmentengagement_enum) describing overall engagement (Non-compliant, High, Medium, Low)

treatmentoutcomes.txsat.desc: An enum (treatmentsatisfaction_enum) describing treatment satisfaction (Medium, Dissatisfied, Low, High)
